landmarks.name: Laas Geel
landmarks.writeup: Ancient cave paintings dating back over 5,000 years, showcasing early African rock art.

landmarks.name: Arba'a Rukun Mosque
landmarks.writeup: One of the oldest mosques in Mogadishu, reflecting Islamic architecture and history.

landmarks.name: Mogadishu Cathedral
landmarks.writeup: A historic cathedral built during Italian colonial rule, symbolizing Somalia's diverse heritage.

cultural_events.name: Eid al-Fitr
cultural_events.writeup: A major Islamic festival marking the end of Ramadan, celebrated with prayers, feasts, and community gatherings.

cultural_events.name: Somali Independence Day
cultural_events.writeup: Celebrated on July 1st, commemorating the unification of British Somaliland and Italian Somaliland in 1960.

food_writeup: Somali cuisine features a blend of Middle Eastern and African flavors, with staple dishes like camel meat, rice, and flatbread, often spiced with cumin, coriander, and cardamom.
brief_history: Somalia has a rich history as a center of ancient trade and Islamic culture. It was colonized by Italy and Britain before gaining independence in 1960. The country has faced civil war and instability since the 1990s but continues efforts toward peace and development.
current_conflicts: Ongoing conflict with militant group Al-Shabaab, political instability, and regional disputes continue to affect Somalia's security and development.
